title: Team Accounts
seo: Team and organization accounts for SaaS apps
meta: Let customers create a team, invite colleagues and manage members from their own area. From $200, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Team accounts, customers invite their own colleagues
overview: Many products grow when one customer brings in colleagues. We turn single-user accounts into team accounts. A customer creates a workspace, invites teammates by email, assigns each one a role and can remove them later. Data belongs to the team, not a single person, so work stays when people leave. We handle invite emails, pending invitations and the rules that keep one team out of another's data.

pkgs.blurb: Workspaces with invites and a member list.
list: Invite by email with a secure link

pkgs.blurb: Several teams per user with roles and a team switcher.
list: One user can join several teams
Up to 4 roles in a team

pkgs.blurb: Seat-based limits, ownership transfer and domain join.
list: Seat limits tied to the plan
Auto-join for a company email domain
Migration of existing users into teams

faq: Can a person belong to more than one team?
Yes in the Standard and Premium packages. They use a switcher to move between teams, and each team keeps its own data, roles and billing details.
How do you keep one team's data apart from another's?
Every record is tied to a team, and every request checks it on the server. We test this with several accounts to look for cases where data could leak.
Can this connect to per-seat billing?
Yes. The Premium package ties seat counts to the plan. The billing side, such as charging per seat, is a separate service in our subscription billing group.
What happens to my existing single users?
They each become the owner of a personal team, so nothing is lost. We plan the move on a copy first and show you before touching live data.
